category_title: Students with disciplinary histories who identify as literacy 'connoisseurs'
student_description: Yusef is a highly capable, voracious reader and aspiring comic book artist who finishes standard work quickly, leading to boredom, internet surfing, and superior behavior toward peers. He reacts to authoritative behavioral management with extreme hostility and withdrawal, uniquely requiring advanced intellectual incentives, integration of his artistic identity, and non-confrontational relational building to remain engaged.

criteria.rationale: Because Yusef finishes work quickly and acts out when bored, he needs high-level reading or writing projects as a reward for completing standard work.
criteria.check: The tutor's response offers an advanced, relevant academic or creative task for Yusef to transition to, rather than asking him to wait for peers or do busywork.

criteria.rationale: Direct commands and forced compliance trigger intense hostility, name-calling, and complete withdrawal from Yusef.
criteria.check: The tutor avoids using direct behavioral commands, forced physical compliance (e.g., moving seats), or threats of formal disciplinary meetings.
